engine_flakiness.boundary_rule: Strict refusal of in-gate normalization. Volatile scrubbing must occur in caller adapter. Unscrubbed engine jitter produces controls_mismatch (exit 1) and is routed to game lane.

product_ownership.boundary_rule: Tameshi verifies repeatable execution of the control command; it refuses product semantics (whether gate's real-world verdicts are true). Nonzero baseline halts evaluation immediately; tameshi never patches or diagnoses sibling product logic.

secrets_and_health.boundary_rule: Commands passed to repeat-control.py must be shape-clean and hermetic; credential material (kagi) and live endpoint health (kama) must never be captured into numbered stdout/stderr artifacts.
secrets_and_health.province_citation: PROVINCE.md:18,45-46 ('Credential material (→ kagi), endpoint health (→ kama)')

case_all_nonzero.routing: Route to product owner: baseline fixture fails cleanly; evaluation refused.

case_divergent_nonzero.routing: Route to product owner: observable instability across pristine runs is a failed control gate.

case_stderr_divergence.routing: Route to owner: unscrubbed telemetry or diagnostic divergence across runs.
